title: Jammed Simulator
summary: Debug a sampling simulation: a draw bigger than its population, a seed inside the loop, and the wrong standard-error formula.
hints: R stops at `sample()`: you can't draw 1,000 *different* values from 564 without putting them back. Add `replace = TRUE`.
Every crew mean is identical, so `se_sim` is 0. Something inside `replicate()` restarts the generator before each draw. A seed belongs once, at the top, not in the loop.
The standard error is σ / √n, not σ / n: `sd(age) / sqrt(10)`.
